'''2003 MegaCon''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Orlando, Florida (1 March 2003). It was the MegaCon Open, a Players Committee Open Qualifier directed by Howard Busch; Keith Molgneaux and [[David Irvine]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031009215036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 October 2003.</ref> Decklists below were recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Orlando, Florida
* '''Dates:''' 1 March 2003
* '''Tournament director:''' Howard Busch<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifiers:''' Keith Molgneaux, [[David Irvine]]<ref name="pc-events03" />
